                          required:
                          - address
                          properties:
                            address:
                              description: 'Source address or network the rule matches.'
                              type: string
                              example: 10.1.24.60
                            port:
                              description: 'Source port the rule matches. Empty or 0 matches any port.'
                              type: integer
                              example: 3389
                        destination:
                          type: object
                          nullable: true
                          required:
                          - address
                          properties:
                            address:
                              description: 'Destination address or network the rule matches.'
                              type: string
                              example: 10.1.24.60
                            port:
                              description: 'Destination port the rule matches. Empty or 0 matches any port.'
                              type: integer
                              example: 3389
        injections:
          description: 'Files phenix copies into the snapshot of the first drive before the VM starts.'
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - src
            - dst
            properties:
              src:
                description: >-
                  File on the phenix host: an absolute path, or a path relative to the experiment directory.
                type: string
                example: foo.xml
              dst:
                description: 'Path the file is written to in the guest.'
                type: string
                example: /etc/phenix/foo.xml
              description:
                description: 'Free-text notes about the file.'
                type: string
                example: phenix config file
              permissions:
                description: 'File mode for the copied file, in octal such as 0664.'
                type: string
                example: '0664'
        delay:
          type: object
          nullable: true
          properties:
            timer:
              description: 'Start the VM this long after the experiment starts, as a duration such as 30s or 5m.'
              type: string
              example: 5m
            user:
              description: >-
                Leave the VM stopped until someone starts it from phenix or minimega. Takes precedence over the other
                delays.
              type: boolean
            c2:
              description: 'Start the VM once each of these hosts has checked in with minimega command and control.'
              type: array
              nullable: true
              items:
                type: object
                properties:
                  hostname:
                    description: 'Host to wait for.'
                    type: string
                  useUUID:
                    description: 'Wait for the host''s UUID, rather than its hostname, to check in.'
                    type: boolean
        advanced:
          description: 'Extra minimega vm config settings, each a setting name and its value.'
          type: object
          nullable: true
          additionalProperties:
            type: string
        commands:
          description: 'minimega command and control (cc) commands phenix sends to the VM, such as exec df -h.'
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: string
          example:
          - exec df -h
    external_node:
      type: object
      required:
      - external
      - type
      - general
      properties:
        external:
          description: >-
            Marks a device phenix does not deploy, such as hardware in the loop. It stays in the topology for State of
            Health and apps.
          type: boolean
        type:
          description: 'What the device is, such as HIL for hardware in the loop.'
          type: string
          default: HIL
          example: HIL
        general:
          type: object
          required:
          - hostname
          properties:
            hostname:
              description: 'Name of the device in the topology.'
              type: string
              example: ADServer
            description:
              description: 'Free-text notes about the device.'
              type: string
              example: Active Directory Server
            vm_type:
              description: 'Whether the device is a virtual machine or a container.'
              type: string
              enum:
              - vm
              - container
              - ""
              default: vm
              example: vm
        hardware:
          type: object
          nullable: true
          required:
          - os_type
          properties:
            cpu:
              description: 'CPU model of the device.'
              type: string
              default: Broadwell
              example: Broadwell
            vcpus:
              description: 'Number of CPUs of the device.'
              oneOf:
              - type: integer
              - type: string
              default: 1
              example: 4
            memory:
              description: 'Memory of the device, in megabytes.'
              oneOf:
              - type: integer
              - type: string
              default: 512
              example: 8192
            os_type:
              description: 'Operating system of the device.'
              type: string
              enum:
              - centos
              - linux
              - minirouter
              - rhel
              - vyatta
              - vyos
              - windows
              - other
              default: linux
              example: windows
        network:
          type: object
          nullable: true
          required:
          - interfaces
          properties:
            interfaces:
              description: >-
                Network interfaces of the device, for the topology's network diagram and State of Health checks.
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                required:
                - name
                properties:
                  name:
                    description: 'Interface name, such as eth0.'
                    type: string
                    example: eth0
                  proto:
                    description: 'How the interface gets its address: static, dhcp, or manual for none.'
                    type: string
                    enum:
                    - static
                    - dhcp
                    - manual
                    - ""
                    default: dhcp
                    example: static
                  address:
                    description: 'IPv4 address of the interface.'
                    type: string
                    format: ipv4
                    example: 192.168.1.100
                  mask:
                    description: 'Network prefix length (CIDR bits), from 0 to 32.'
                    type: integer
                    minimum: 0
                    maximum: 32
                    default: 24
                    example: 24
                  gateway:
                    description: 'Default gateway of the interface.'
                    type: string
                    format: ipv4
                    example: 192.168.1.1
                  vlan:
                    description: 'VLAN (network) the interface is on.'
                    type: string
                    example: EXP-1
    iface:
      type: object
      required:
      - name
      - vlan
      properties:
        name:
          description: 'Interface name, such as eth0, which NAT settings and apps use to refer to it.'
          type: string
          example: eth0
        vlan:
          description: 'VLAN (network) the interface is on.'
          type: string
          example: EXP-1
        autostart:
          description: >-
            Whether the interface should come up when the VM boots. phenix itself does not act on this setting.
          type: boolean
          default: true
        mac:
          description: 'MAC address. minimega generates one when it is empty.'
          type: string
          example: 00:11:22:33:44:55
          pattern: '^$|^([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:-]){5}([0-9a-fA-F]){2}$'
        mtu:
          description: >-
            Maximum transmission unit, in bytes. Vyatta and VyOS routers apply values from 68 to 16000; other images
            keep their own.
          type: integer
          default: 1500
          example: 1500
        bridge:
          description: >-
            Open vSwitch bridge on the host the interface attaches to. Empty or phenix uses the experiment's default
            bridge.
          type: string
          default: phenix
        driver:
          description: 'Emulated network card, such as e1000 or virtio-net-pci. Empty uses minimega''s default.'
          type: string
          example: e1000
        qinq:
          description: >-
            Carry the guest's own VLAN tags inside the interface's VLAN (QinQ, 802.1ad). The guest brings the interface
            up without an address.
          type: boolean
          default: false
    iface_address:
      type: object
      required:
      - address
      - mask
      properties:
        address:
          description: 'IPv4 address of the interface.'
          type: string
          format: ipv4
          example: 192.168.1.100
        mask:
          description: 'Network prefix length (CIDR bits), from 0 to 32.'
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 32
          default: 24
          example: 24
        gateway:
          description: 'Default gateway, reached through this interface.'
          type: string
          format: ipv4
          example: 192.168.1.1
        dns:
          description: 'DNS server addresses the guest uses: one address, or a list.'
          nullable: true
          oneOf:
          - type: string
          - type: array
            items:
              type: string
          example:
          - 192.168.1.1
          - 192.168.1.2
    iface_rulesets:
      type: object
      properties:
        ruleset_out:
          description: 'Ruleset for traffic going out of this interface, on Router and Firewall nodes.'
          type: string
          example: OutToInet
          pattern: '^[\w-]*$'
        ruleset_in:
          description: 'Ruleset for traffic coming in on this interface, on Router and Firewall nodes.'
          type: string
          example: InFromInet
          pattern: '^[\w-]*$'
    static_iface:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_address'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_rulesets'
      required:
      - type
      - proto
      properties:
        type:
          description: 'Kind of interface: ethernet.'
          type: string
          enum:
          - ethernet
          default: ethernet
          example: ethernet
        proto:
          description: >-
            How the interface is addressed: static for a fixed address, or ospf for a fixed address that also takes part
            in OSPF on a router.
          type: string
          enum:
          - static
          - ospf
          default: static
          example: static
    dhcp_iface:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_rulesets'
      required:
      - type
      - proto
      properties:
        type:
          description: 'Kind of interface: ethernet.'
          type: string
          enum:
          - ethernet
          default: ethernet
          example: ethernet
        proto:
          description: >-
            How the interface is addressed: dhcp to ask a DHCP server, or manual to bring it up with no address.
          type: string
          enum:
          - dhcp
          - manual
          default: dhcp
          example: dhcp
    serial_iface:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_address'
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/iface_rulesets'
      required:
      - type
      - proto
      - udp_port
      - baud_rate
      - device
      properties:
        type:
          description: 'Kind of interface: a serial link, carried over the network between VMs.'
          type: string
          enum:
          - serial
          default: serial
          example: serial
        proto:
          description: 'Serial interfaces have a static address.'
          type: string
          enum:
          - static
          default: static
          example: static
        udp_port:
          description: 'UDP port that carries the serial traffic between VMs.'
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 65535
          default: 8989
          example: 8989
        baud_rate:
          description: 'Speed of the serial line, in bits per second.'
          type: integer
          enum:
          - 110
          - 300
          - 600
          - 1200
          - 2400
          - 4800
          - 9600
          - 14400
          - 19200
          - 38400
          - 57600
          - 115200
          - 128000
          - 256000
          default: 9600
          example: 9600
        device:
          description: 'Serial device the guest uses, such as /dev/ttyS0.'
          type: string
          default: /dev/ttyS0
          example: /dev/ttyS0
</code></pre>

# Schemas for the config kinds stored at apiVersion phenix.sandia.gov/v2:
# Scenario. Configs are validated against the schema file of their own
# apiVersion, so a kind appears only in the file of the version it is
# stored at (see version.StoredVersion).
# The "--8<--" comments mark the sections docs/content/schema.md shows; the
# last section runs to the end of the file.
openapi: "3.0.0"
info:
  title: phenix config specs
  version: "2.0"
paths: {}
components:
  schemas:
    Scenario:
      type: object
      nullable: true
      required:
      - apps
      properties:
        apps:
          type: array
          nullable: true
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - name
            properties:
              name:
                type: string
                example: example-app
              assetDir:
                type: string
                example: /phenix/topologies/example-topo/assets

                nullable: true
                additionalProperties: true
                example:
                  setting0: true
                  setting1: 42
                  setting2: universe key
              disabled:
                type: boolean
                default: false
                example: false
                nullable: true
              hosts:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  required:
                  - hostname
                  properties:
                    hostname:
                      type: string
